name: Hotel Garni Almfried
beschreibung: The Hotel Garni Almfried is located in a quiet setting in Tirol, Österreich. The surroundings are characterized by mountains and nature. Nearby there are several ski areas and hiking trails for use in winter and summer. The atmosphere at the hotel is quiet and relaxed. Amenities include comfortable rooms, a breakfast buffet, and free Wi-Fi. Guests can expect a stay in an alpine ambience with direct access to nature.
